title: The Treaty-Anchor of Port Hunding
summary: Foil a plot by Thalmor-backed privateers and undead necromancers from N'Gasta's Isle to steal the brass Dwemer harbor-engine of Bthzark and sabotage the Stros M'Kai Treaty Commemoration.

npcs.name: Harbour-Warden Zahid
npcs.greet: Welcome to Stros M'Kai, friend! Every ship in Port Hunding is dressing its masts for the Treaty Commemoration—yet someone is cutting throats in the drydocks.
talk: On this island our grandfathers forced the Empire to sign the Second Treaty of Stros M'Kai and drove the Aldmeri Dominion into the sea.
Last night smugglers broke into the customs house at Port Hunding and stole the Dwemer pressure-key to Bthzark, alongside the brass Treaty-Anchor. Speak with Bosun Latifa at the Draggin' Tale Inn.

npcs.name: Bosun Latifa
npcs.greet: If you're looking for honest smugglers, we're drinking rum in the light! None of our crews touched the Treaty-Anchor!
talk: Corsair-Captain Vane and a pale necromancer from the western islet paid off a rogue customs clerk and carried the Dwemer key into Berud Tombs.
They're robbing the ancient navigator crypts in Berud Tombs to find the chart into Bthzark's lower sea-gate!

npcs.name: Antiquarian Farooq
npcs.greet: By Hunding's compass, if Vane opens the lower sea-gate of Bthzark, the Dwemer steam-mines will flood Port Hunding's harbour with boiling oil!
talk: Stop Necromancer Sulon inside Berud Tombs first to recover the navigator's chart, then pursue Captain Vane into the brass halls of Bthzark.

npcs.name: Marine-Captain Tariq
npcs.greet: Hold hard! My marines have secured the upper lift of Bthzark, but Vane's corsairs have rigged the Dwemer oil-conduits below.
talk: Cut Vane down at the central flywheel before he releases the boiling pitch into Port Hunding!

story_sm_port_hunding_vault: Antiquarian Farooq: Look at the empty pedestal in Port Hunding's customs vault—both the Treaty-Anchor and the Dwemer key of Bthzark are gone.
Bosun Latifa: And look at the green corpse-wax dripped on the flagstones. Only grave-robbers from the western islet burn candles like that.
Antiquarian Farooq: Hurry to Berud Tombs before they force the navigator's sarcophagus!
story_sm_berud_crypt: Sulon of the Western Islet: Even in death, Hunding's navigators know the secret channels beneath Stros M'Kai! Give me the brass chart, spectre!
Bosun Latifa: Put your blade through that grave-defiler before he binds the pilot's ghost!
story_sm_bthzark_flywheel: Corsair-Captain Vane: My Thalmor patrons paid ten thousand golden eagles to see Port Hunding's Treaty fleet burn at anchor!
Marine-Captain Tariq: Stros M'Kai broke the Dominion once, traitor, and we'll break you today!

quests.title: The Stolen Key of Bthzark
quests.summary: Inspect the robbed customs vault at Port Hunding and question Bosun Latifa at the Draggin' Tale Inn.
intro: On the eve of the Second Treaty commemoration, thieves broke into Port Hunding's customs house and stole the Treaty-Anchor and the Dwemer key to Bthzark.
Inspect the customs vault at Port Hunding with Antiquarian Farooq and speak with Bosun Latifa at the Draggin' Tale Inn.
complete: Bosun Latifa identified the thieves as Corsair-Captain Vane and a necromancer from the western islet heading toward Berud Tombs.

journal.start: Harbour-Warden Zahid in Stros M'Kai sent me to Port Hunding and the Draggin' Tale Inn to trace the stolen key of Bthzark.
journal.done: Bosun Latifa directed me to Berud Tombs where the thieves are seeking a Dwemer sea-chart.

quests.title: The Navigator's Tomb
quests.summary: Enter Berud Tombs and defeat Sulon of the Western Islet before he seizes the Dwemer sea-chart.
intro: Sulon of the Western Islet has broken into Berud Tombs to interrogate the spirits of ancient Redguard navigators.
Enter Berud Tombs and slay Sulon.
complete: Sulon fell in Berud Tombs, revealing that Corsair-Captain Vane has already unlocked the upper doors of Bthzark.

journal.start: I must enter Berud Tombs and defeat Sulon of the Western Islet.
journal.done: I defeated Sulon in Berud Tombs and learned Vane is preparing to flood Port Hunding with boiling pitch from Bthzark.

quests.title: Signal-Fires at Sulush Ruins
quests.summary: Extinguish the corsair signal-beacon at Sulush Ruins and join Marine-Captain Tariq at Bthzark.
intro: Vane's lookouts at Sulush Ruins have lit a signal-brazier to guide an Aldmeri privateer brig into the cove.
Douse the signal at Sulush Ruins and meet Marine-Captain Tariq at the entrance to Bthzark.
complete: With the signal at Sulush Ruins doused, Marine-Captain Tariq breached the outer lift of Bthzark.

journal.start: I must clear the corsair lookout at Sulush Ruins and meet Marine-Captain Tariq at Bthzark.
journal.done: I doused the corsair signal at Sulush Ruins and joined Marine-Captain Tariq at Bthzark.

quests.title: The Brass Flywheel of Bthzark
quests.summary: Descend into the Dwemer engine-halls of Bthzark, defeat Corsair-Captain Vane, and return the Treaty-Anchor to Harbour-Warden Zahid in Stros M'Kai.
intro: Deep inside Bthzark, Corsair-Captain Vane is turning the Dwemer pitch-valves to burn the ships gathered in Port Hunding.
Defeat Captain Vane in Bthzark and return the Treaty-Anchor to Harbour-Warden Zahid in Stros M'Kai.
complete: Corsair-Captain Vane is dead, the Dwemer pitch-valves of Bthzark are locked fast, and the Treaty bells ring across Port Hunding.

journal.start: I must defeat Corsair-Captain Vane in Bthzark and return the Treaty-Anchor to Harbour-Warden Zahid in Stros M'Kai.
journal.done: I defeated Corsair-Captain Vane in Bthzark and saved the Port Hunding fleet.
